content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
A flock of birds wrote an initial in the sky for me. It felt like a signal.
I can’t confirm signaling from flocks. What was the formation shape and how long did it last?
About five seconds. It looked like a big S, then broke apart.
Short, high-variability formations are common with wind shifts. Capturing video on multiple days at the same location can show how often letter-like shapes emerge by chance.
A frame-by-frame look across recordings can count approximate hits versus total formations, giving a frequency estimate to compare with other spots and times.
I’ll record during the same hour each day this week.
